eslint.config.mjs: The lint rules themselves. eslint loads this, and the `lint` step in .github/workflows/js-unit-suite.yml is the gate on it.
tools/lissajous_page.js: tools/lissajous.html's entry module. Importing it builds the page: it calls bootstrapTool() at the top level, which stands up a WebGL scene the fake DOM cannot provide. Its math is tests/lissajous_math.test.js's subject, its rational lock is scripts/lissajous-probe.mjs's, and the rest of the page only the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/mobius_page.js: tools/mobius.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene at the top level; its transforms are covered by tests/mobius_transforms.test.js, its complex-plane pads by scripts/mobius-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/palettes_page.js: tools/palettes.html's entry module. Importing it binds the page DOM at the top level; its math and controls are covered by their unit tests, its strip-zoom and hue-key-wheel pointer handlers by scripts/palettes-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
tools/solids_page.js: tools/solids.html's entry module. Importing it builds a WebGL scene and loads the WASM engine at the top level; its helpers are covered by their unit tests, its op-chain reorder by scripts/solids-probe.mjs, and the rest of the page only by the load smoke in scripts/browser-smoke.mjs.
main.js: index.html's entry module, whose body is `void bootstrap()`. Importing it starts the simulator, which is why bootstrap.js stays separately importable and tests/bootstrap.test.js covers it there.
vendor-importmap.js: An IIFE the page loads by script tag, not a module. tests/vendor-importmap.test.js evaluates its source in a node:vm sandbox, which is not a module load.
scripts/browser-smoke.mjs: Drives headless Chrome over every manifest-served page. The reusable browser workflow runs it, and there is no part of it a unit test could reach without a browser.
scripts/generate-digest-migration.mjs: Regenerates digest_migration.v1v2.json from the v1 fixtures on import, so a test load would rewrite the working tree. The migration-table completeness case fails if the committed table drifts from what a rerun would write.
scripts/record-module-loads.mjs: Loaded through NODE_OPTIONS before its own loader hook exists; a missing recorder leaves source modules uncovered and fails the roster gate.

driver.js.reason: The WebGL constructor and renderer event wiring require browser coverage; unit tests exercise sizing, draw, and teardown paths through the prototype. scripts/browser-smoke.mjs and the interaction probes exercise construction in Chrome.

daydream.js.reason: Composition-root GUI callbacks and late lifecycle error paths are only partially driven by the fake application tests; browser probes exercise the live controls.

scripts/check-cdn-integrity.mjs.reason: The command-line exit path is outside imported-helper tests; CI invokes the command against the pinned CDN resources.

scripts/generate-importmap.mjs.reason: Tracked CLI fixture suites cover dependency reads, hashing, addon scans and import-map rewriting. Remaining gaps include malformed package metadata and filesystem/tool failures.

scripts/vendor-stage.mjs.reason: Server startup and filesystem cleanup error paths require infrastructure failures; fixture tests exercise staging and normal shutdown.

scripts/verify-ci-green.mjs.reason: The CLI reads the workflow and needs-result JSON from local files; tests/ci_workflow.test.js covers imported parsers and verdicts, while the CLI file-reading and exit paths run in CI.

tools/shader_documents.js.reason: Halt paths are covered by shader_documents.test.js. Remaining gaps include default browser fetch/download callbacks, missing catalog selections, and optional UI mounts; these are partial unit coverage, not a claim that they are unreachable.

tools/chain_strip.js.reason: Remaining branches include focus restoration, pointer capture and viewport geometry fallbacks, optional controls, and teardown after DOM removal. The fake DOM covers editing; browser probes cover native focus and pointer behavior.

scripts/browser.mjs.reason: The import-time LOCALAPPDATA branch depends on the host environment. Resolver fixtures cover explicit paths, candidate selection and missing executables; they do not reload the module under both Windows environment states.

tools/shared.js.reason: Remaining branches include optional scene callbacks, renderer teardown and browser sizing fallbacks. Mocked scene tests cover construction and disposal; live WebGL and layout behavior is exercised by browser probes.

effect_panel_view.js.reason: Browser probes exercise focused controller DOM paths.

effect_roster.js.reason: Malformed engine roster error paths are not all exercised by fixture modules.

module_warmer.js.reason: Browser module preload fallback paths are partially exercised by unit fixtures.
